sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (currency = 'BRL'), "locale" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('asset', 'income', 'expense', 'equity', 'liability')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ledger_accounts(id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('bank', 'wallet')), "opened_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense')), "parent_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "cost_nature" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (cost_nature IN ('fixed', 'variable')), "essential" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (essential IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (archived IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0), CHECK(parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id != id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "financial_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('opening_balance', 'income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'reversal', 'card_purchase', 'card_opening', 'card_payment')), "effective_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "idempotency_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "reversal_of" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES financial_events(id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(profile_id, idempotency_key), CHECK((kind = 'reversal' AND reversal_of IS NOT NULL)OR(kind != 'reversal' AND reversal_of IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "postings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES financial_events(id), "ledger_account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ledger_accounts(id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence IN (0, 1)), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents != 0 AND amount_cents BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991), "category_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "cost_nature" TEXT CHECK (cost_nature IN ('fixed', 'variable')), "essential" INTEGER CHECK (essential IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE(event_id, sequence));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "operation_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "command" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (command IN ('create_account', 'create_category', 'record', 'reverse', 'create_card', 'purchase', 'pay_invoice', 'create_schedule', 'create_series', 'revise_series', 'pause_series', 'resume_series', 'edit_scheduled', 'skip_scheduled', 'settle_scheduled', 'save_objective', 'save_goal', 'move_goal_funds', 'set_goal_status')), "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX events_by_date ON financial_events (profile_id, effective_date, created_at)
CREATE INDEX postings_by_account ON postings (ledger_account_id, event_id)
CREATE INDEX postings_by_category ON postings (category_id, event_id)
CREATE INDEX categories_by_parent ON categories (parent_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_cards" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES ledger_accounts(id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "opened_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "limit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(limit_cents) = 'integer' AND limit_cents BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991), "closing_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (closing_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "due_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (due_day BETWEEN 1 AND 31), "closing_policy" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (closing_policy IN ('next', 'current')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "card_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES financial_events(id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_cards(id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('purchase', 'opening_debt')), "billing_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "installment_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (installment_count BETWEEN 1 AND 360), "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(total_cents) = 'integer' AND total_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "reconciled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (reconciled IN (0, 1)), CHECK(installment_count <= total_cents));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_cards(id), "closing_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_on" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (due_on > closing_on), UNIQUE(card_id, closing_on));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES card_operations(id), "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id), "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 360), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), UNIQUE(operation_id, sequence));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES financial_events(id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "card_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES credit_cards(id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_payment_allocations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoice_payments(id), "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), UNIQUE(payment_id, invoice_id));
CREATE INDEX invoices_by_due ON invoices (due_on, card_id)
CREATE INDEX items_by_invoice ON invoice_items (invoice_id)
CREATE INDEX allocations_by_invoice ON invoice_payment_allocations (invoice_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_series" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'card_purchase')), "paused_on" TEXT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rule_versions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "series_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurrence_series(id), "valid_from" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_current" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_current IN (0, 1)), "valid_until" TEXT, "anchor_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (frequency IN ('daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly')), "interval_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (interval_count BETWEEN 1 AND 1200), "last_day" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (last_day IN (0, 1)), "end_on" TEXT, "max_occurrences" INTEGER CHECK (max_occurrences BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000), "description" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "account_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "destination_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "card_id" TEXT REFERENCES credit_cards(id), "category_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "cost_nature" TEXT CHECK (cost_nature IN ('fixed', 'variable')), "essential" INTEGER CHECK (essential IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "series_id" TEXT REFERENCES recurrence_series(id), "rule_version_id" TEXT REFERENCES recurrence_rule_versions(id), "ordinal" INTEGER CHECK (ordinal > 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('income', 'expense', 'transfer', 'card_purchase')), "scheduled_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(description)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160), "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991), "account_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "destination_id" TEXT REFERENCES accounts(id), "card_id" TEXT REFERENCES credit_cards(id), "category_id" TEXT REFERENCES categories(id), "cost_nature" TEXT CHECK (cost_nature IN ('fixed', 'variable')), "essential" INTEGER CHECK (essential IN (0, 1)), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'settled', 'skipped', 'cancelled')), "settled_event_id" TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES financial_events(id), "is_manual_override" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_manual_override IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0), UNIQUE(rule_version_id, ordinal), CHECK((series_id IS NULL AND rule_version_id IS NULL AND ordinal IS NULL)OR(series_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_version_id IS NOT NULL AND ordinal IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((status = 'settled' AND settled_event_id IS NOT NULL)OR(status != 'settled' AND settled_event_id IS NULL)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX occurrence_by_series_date ON scheduled_occurrences (series_id, scheduled_on) WHERE status != 'cancelled'
CREATE INDEX scheduled_by_date ON scheduled_occurrences (status, scheduled_on)
CREATE INDEX rules_by_series ON recurrence_rule_versions (series_id, valid_from)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX current_rule_per_series ON recurrence_rule_versions (series_id) WHERE is_current = 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "objectives" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'archived')), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "objective_id" TEXT REFERENCES objectives(id), "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(title)) BETWEEN 1 AND 80), "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (purpose IN ('emergency', 'purchase', 'general')), "target_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(target_cents) = 'integer' AND target_cents > 0 AND target_cents <= 9007199254740991), "target_on" TEXT, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (priority BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'paused', 'fulfilled', 'archived')), "fulfilled_on" TEXT, "fulfilled_cents" INTEGER CHECK (fulfilled_cents IS NULL OR fulfilled_cents >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (revision > 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goal_fund_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(id), "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES goals(id), "account_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), "effective_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(amount_cents) = 'integer' AND amount_cents != 0 AND amount_cents BETWEEN -9007199254740991 AND 9007199254740991), "sequence_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0), "request_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(request_id), UNIQUE(goal_id, account_id, sequence_no));
CREATE INDEX goals_by_status ON goals (profile_id, status, priority)
CREATE INDEX goal_movements_by_goal ON goal_fund_movements (goal_id, effective_on)
CREATE INDEX goal_movements_by_account ON goal_fund_movements (account_id, effective_on)
